_doc: Revert-verify mutants for RFC 14217015 P1.2 (vault-exodev task 09d2bd28, req 9fddda62 regression coverage): ClassHierarchyResolvingStore.matchHierarchySubject returns the UNION of a symbolic class subject's direct edges (a reified exo__Statement of an adapter, EKA D5) and its file-IRI edges (the class's own frontmatter). Each mutant removes one half of that contract and must redden exactly the axes named in `expect`. `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › Dn @req…`, not on the bare key (integration-test-revert-verify §A44/§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145). D6 (Instance_class emitted as the class uid, RFC 78572fa9 flip ON) carries no mutant: it is green on the pre-fix base too and pins that the union does not disturb that mode — a walk entering the class by its FILE IRI never consults the symbolic subject.

M1_direct_edges_short_circuit_restored._note: The pre-fix behaviour: any direct edge on the symbolic subject suppresses the file-IRI bridge, so a decorated class loses its native ancestors (the defect of RFC 14217015 §Q3).

M2_union_without_dedup._note: A Statement restating a native edge yields the same rewritten triple from both halves; without the dedup the one-hop result doubles.
M2_union_without_dedup.from:
// A Statement restating a native edge yields the same rewritten triple twice.
    return ClassHierarchyResolvingStore.dedupTriples([...direct, ...rewritten]);
M2_union_without_dedup.to:
// A Statement restating a native edge yields the same rewritten triple twice.
    return [...direct, ...rewritten];

M3_direct_edges_dropped_when_file_has_no._note: A decorated ROOT class has no native edge on its file IRI; returning the empty bridged result instead of the direct one drops its adapter parent.

M4_direct_edges_dropped_from_union._note: The mirror of M1: the file-IRI edges replace the direct ones instead of joining them, so the adapter parent of a class with native ancestors vanishes.
M4_direct_edges_dropped_from_union.from:
// A Statement restating a native edge yields the same rewritten triple twice.
    return ClassHierarchyResolvingStore.dedupTriples([...direct, ...rewritten]);
M4_direct_edges_dropped_from_union.to:
// A Statement restating a native edge yields the same rewritten triple twice.
    return rewritten;
